misuse.text: Don't tell someone sad to 'touch grass'.
misuse.why: It sounds dismissive of their feelings.

publish.title: What does "touch grass" mean?
publish.value: Touch grass = Go outside, get offline. Example: "Touch grass, it's sunny out." (very casual English, US).
